long_biography.plain_text:
Elizabeth A. Logan is among the descendants covered by the Scripps shareholder compact. That arrangement grew from a trust established to preserve the independence of E.W. Scripps's publishing businesses. When the trust ended, beneficiaries received stock subject to coordinated voting and transfer restrictions; Logan held direct shares alongside voting rights attributed through the wider family group.

A separate cable portfolio brought HGTV, Food Network, Travel Channel and DIY Network under Scripps Networks Interactive. Discovery bought the company in a cash-and-stock transaction, with holders receiving merger consideration for each share. Beyond media ownership, Logan serves without pay as co-chair and secretary of the Robert A. Buzzelli Charitable Foundation.
